verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://developers.clerky.com/llms.txt. The file indexes agent-readable markdown pages (index.md for Introduction, Lifecycle, Authentication and the MCP Server guide), and those pages are themselves served as clean markdown, so an agent can be pointed straight at them. The 404s on handbooks.clerky.com only show that the separate legal handbook site lacks llms.txt and .md versions; they do not contradict the developer docs. missing for 10: llms.txt/markdown coverage of the handbooks.clerky.com content, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the docs
